cover.alt: Vakya owner desk showing the Doctor consultations schedule as a week calendar. In the Ask like a caller panel, a Hinglish message asks whether a 6 pm slot tomorrow is free; the desk highlights Thursday 6 pm on the calendar and answers in Hindi that the slot is free

gallery.alt: Vakya Front desk page for a sample clinic, Green Valley Clinic Reception: Ready to answer in English, Hindi and Marathi, with its greeting and the written instructions it follows on every call
gallery.caption: A front desk starts from a template, here a clinic. The owner edits the greeting and the instructions the agent follows on every call, such as reading the time back and booking only after the caller says yes.

gallery.alt: Vakya report card table of booking completion by audio condition (clean, 8 kHz phone line, G.711 codec, street noise at 10, 5 and 0 dB, phone line with noise), with and without keyterms, word error and median time, followed by a table of which booking field was lost
gallery.caption: The report card plays 24 invented booking calls in Hindi, Marathi and Hinglish through phone-line and noise conditions, then scores whether the name, day and time all survived. The audio is synthetic speech, and the page says so.
